mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "resTotal", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '내과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resInternal", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '정형외과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resOrthopedics", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '신경외과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resNeurosurgery", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '소아청소년과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resPediatrics", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '이비인후과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resEnt", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '피부과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resDermatology", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '안과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resOphthalmology", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '치과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resDentistry", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '정신건강의학과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resPsychiatry" FROM reservation r JOIN med_dept d ON r.med_dept_id = d.med_dept_id WHERE r.reservation_date = #{targetDate} AND r.reservation_time >= #{targetTime} AND r.reservation_time < (CAST(#{targetTime} AS TIME) + INTERVAL '30 minutes') AND r.reservation_status = '예약'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "resTotal", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '내과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resInternal", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '정형외과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resOrthopedics", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '신경외과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resNeurosurgery", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '소아청소년과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resPediatrics", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '이비인후과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resEnt", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '피부과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resDermatology", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '안과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resOphthalmology", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '치과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resDentistry", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.med_dept_name = '정신건강의학과' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "resPsychiatry" FROM reservation r JOIN med_dept d ON r.med_dept_id = d.med_dept_id WHERE r.reservation_date = #{targetDate} AND r.reservation_status = '예약'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parking_prediction ( target_datetime, predicted_cars, forecast_type, temp, rainfall_mm, wind_speed, humidity, snowfall_cm, pm10, pm25, pm10_grade, pm25_grade, is_holiday, res_internal, res_orthopedics, res_pediatrics, res_neurosurgery, res_ent, res_dermatology, res_ophthalmology, res_dentistry, res_psychiatry, res_total ) VALUES ( #{targetDatetime}, #{predictedCars}, #{forecastType}, #{temp}, #{rainfallMm}, #{windSpeed}, #{humidity}, #{snowfallCm}, #{pm10}, #{pm25}, #{pm10Grade}, #{pm25Grade}, #{isHoliday}, #{resInternal}, #{resOrthopedics}, #{resPediatrics}, #{resNeurosurgery}, #{resEnt}, #{resDermatology}, #{resOphthalmology}, #{resDentistry}, #{resPsychiatry}, #{resTotal} ) ON CONFLICT (target_datetime) DO UPDATE SET predicted_cars = EXCLUDED.predicted_cars, forecast_type = EXCLUDED.forecast_type, temp = EXCLUDED.temp, rainfall_mm = EXCLUDED.rainfall_mm, wind_speed = EXCLUDED.wind_speed, humidity = EXCLUDED.humidity, snowfall_cm = EXCLUDED.snowfall_cm, pm10 = EXCLUDED.pm10, pm25 = EXCLUDED.pm25, pm10_grade = EXCLUDED.pm10_grade, pm25_grade = EXCLUDED.pm25_grade, is_holiday = EXCLUDED.is_holiday, res_internal = EXCLUDED.res_internal, res_orthopedics = EXCLUDED.res_orthopedics, res_pediatrics = EXCLUDED.res_pediatrics, res_neurosurgery = EXCLUDED.res_neurosurgery, res_ent = EXCLUDED.res_ent, res_dermatology = EXCLUDED.res_dermatology, res_ophthalmology = EXCLUDED.res_ophthalmology, res_dentistry = EXCLUDED.res_dentistry, res_psychiatry = EXCLUDED.res_psychiatry, res_total = EXCLUDED.res_total, predicted_time = now();
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(p.target_datetime, 'HH24:MI') AS "time", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(p.predicted_cars)), 0) AS "predictedCars", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_log l WHERE l.entry_time <= p.target_datetime AND (l.exit_time IS NULL OR l.exit_time > p.target_datetime) ) )), 0) AS "actualCars" FROM parking_prediction p WHERE p.target_datetime::date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND p.forecast_type != 'mid' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(p.target_datetime, 'HH24:MI') ORDER BY "time" ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(target_datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", ROUND(AVG(predicted_cars)) AS "predictedCars", BOOL_OR(is_holiday) AS "isHoliday" FROM parking_prediction WHERE target_datetime::date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND forecast_type = 'mid' AND ( is_holiday = true OR EXTRACT(DOW FROM target_datetime) = 0 OR ( EXTRACT(DOW FROM target_datetime) = 6 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM target_datetime) BETWEEN 9 AND 12) OR ( EXTRACT(DOW FROM target_datetime) NOT IN (0, 6) AND is_holiday = false AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM target_datetime) BETWEEN 9 AND 18) ) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(target_datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY "date" ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_prediction WHERE target_datetime::date = #{targetDate} AND forecast_type != 'mid'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_prediction WHERE target_datetime::date = #{targetDate} AND forecast_type = 'mid'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_prediction WHERE target_datetime = #{targetDatetime} AND forecast_type != 'mid'
SELECT target_datetime AS "targetDatetime", forecast_type AS "forecastType" FROM parking_prediction WHERE target_datetime::date = #{targetDate} AND forecast_type != 'vshort'
